label: JCD K-Barbecue (Korean BBQ)
note: Five portrait pages (p3–7 of the PDF; p1–2 are a cover and a 'how to grill' welcome page, excluded). Photo-card grid: every item has a code (A1, B4, H2, E17), a Hangul name in red, a romanised name, and a short English description. Names in the truth are the romanised line, with Hangul as an alias; the matcher compares Latin text only. The restaurant name is not printed in Latin script on these pages — '장충동' (Jangchungdong, the 'JCD') appears only inside two dish names in Hangul — so restaurantName is null. Traps: Bossam, Jokbal, Pork Bulgogi, Chicken Bulgogi and Bulgogi each appear twice in different sections (shareable/BBQ vs entrée) and are genuinely different orders; BBQ Combo A/B list components (with photos) that are not separate orders; the PDF text layer on p4 contains a SIDE ORDER block (Corn Cheese, Egg, Side Rice…) that is NOT visible on the rendered page — it is deliberately not in the truth, and returning it would mean reading something no diner can see. The printed 'Galbi)' typo on E-page is kept verbatim.
